messages:
maria_marketing: Quick ask for the launch PR and webinar—marketing needs a reproducible bench package from runtime that we can link in the appendix. Items requested: exact run command(s), model tags (including any patched weights), quant config, warmup traffic generator, number of warmup tokens per worker, full per-request latency traces, and 10 representative outputs per workload slice. Deadline: EOD Fri. @neil_runtime can you own?

neil_runtime: Yep I can own. Couple clarifying points: which workloads do you want as slices? Our standard set is: short Q/A, long context (8k), code generation, multi-turn chat. Anything else?

maria_marketing: Use those four. Also ask for a separate tiny slice for "edge-case prompts" (nonsense + long tail) so we can show failure modes. We need CSV with columns: slice, seed, variant, prompt_len, response_tokens, latency_ms, kv_cache_hit, model_tag. Include a small human-readable README describing how slices were sampled.

oscar_sre: Please ensure artifacts include provenance: run_id, UTC timestamp, git commit hash, docker image sha256, and the infra tag (e.g., dedicated-pool-3). Also request that the artifacts are ACL'd to rw-marketing and rw-runtime and marked embargoed until 2026-04-10 as per launch calendar.

maria_marketing: Embargo confirmed until 2026-04-10. Also please include the exact curl/snippet we can paste in docs and the SDK call example in Python. Example curl we expect: 

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-gpt-large:v3","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<prompt>"}],"max_tokens":256}'

neil_runtime: We'll include both curl and python snippets. One more: do you want both fp16 baseline and the quantized release (q4/q8) side-by-side?

maria_marketing: Yes — baseline FP16 + primary demo quant variant q4_kv and an aggressive q8_kv for a cost/loss tradeoff table. Include the quant config files and any layer exceptions.

benchbot: artifact-uploader: uploaded 1815007777-package/ to s3://redwood-bench/marketing/1815007777/ (permissions: rw-marketing, rw-runtime). Manifest: manifest-1815007777.json.

neil_runtime: Plan: 1) run a focused reproducibility sweep for seeds 1001-1010 across the 4+edge slices, 2) collect per-token timing and KV cache hits, 3) produce samples.csv + samples.jsonl (one JSON per sample) + logs.tar.gz + reproducibility.md. ETA: 24 hours.

maria_marketing: ETA sounds good. Also can you compute per-run token-cost estimate (approx $ per 1k tokens) and add a short blurb about batch settings that materially change latency (batch_size, batch_timeout_ms) so we don't misinterpret numbers in live traffic?

neil_runtime: Will add cost estimate using our accounting model (tokens * unit_cost under current pricing) and a short note on batching. We'll annotate which numbers are measured with batching disabled vs enabled.

oscar_sre: Heads-up: include the exact load profile used for warmup (concurrency, ramp, steady state, duration) and a pointer to the warmup script warmup_runner.sh. Without that, folks can't reproduce cold vs warmed comparisons.

maria_marketing: Also want a short paragraph for legal on data provenance: confirm that samples are synthetic or anonymized and that no customer prompts are leaked.

cara_csm: Please add customer-success to the artifact ACL once uploaded (they need access to triage leads after launch).

neil_runtime: Will do. I'm kicking off the sweep now. Will ping when artifacts are ready.

benchbot: job-scheduler: reproducibility-sweep #998 started (tags: q4_kv, q8_kv, fp16, slices=5). Logs will stream to s3 path above.

neil_runtime: Sweep finished. Summary (quick): fp16 warmed p50=34ms p95=88ms p99=190ms; q4_kv warmed p50=38ms p95=102ms p99=230ms; q8_kv warmed p50=30ms p95=140ms p99=420ms (note higher tail on q8). Coldstart numbers attached. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/marketing/1815007777/manifest-1815007777.json, samples.csv, samples.jsonl, warmup_runner.sh, reproducibility.md, run-logs.tar.gz.

maria_marketing: Perfect — dropping into the launch doc now. I'll run a quick spot check on samples.csv and reply if anything looks off. Thanks team :rocket:
